title: `Promise.race` returns the timeout record without awaiting `runBody()`
text: `Promise.race` returns the timeout record without awaiting `runBody()`. A model client that ignores abort can keep its request in flight while the next campaign run begins, causing overlapping/duplicate external calls and corrupting per-run cost evidence. Drain or otherwise prevent advancement until the timed-out request settles.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 9d2cbee, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
